quirks.description: Bootstrap sites use .container > .row > .col-* nesting. The .container adds max-width + centering. The .row uses flexbox with negative margins.
quirks.workaround: Map .container to Tailwind max-w-[1320px] mx-auto px-4. Extract computed styles for grid columns.

quirks.description: Foundation 6+ uses .grid-container > .grid-x > .cell. Older Foundation uses .row > .columns. Class names differ from Bootstrap.
quirks.workaround: Extract computed styles for all grid elements. Do not attempt class-name-to-Tailwind mapping for Foundation.

quirks.description: Hand-coded HTML may have 15+ direct body children (h1, p, ul) with no section wrappers. Section discovery sees each as a separate section.
quirks.workaround: Existing mega-section unwrap and min-height filters handle most cases. For very flat structures, sections are just smaller.

quirks.description: Static sites use relative paths (./images/logo.png, css/style.css). No CDN domain patterns to match.
quirks.workaround: Resolve all image and asset URLs against the page base URL.

quirks.description: Hand-coded sites frequently use inline style attributes and <style> blocks instead of external stylesheets.
quirks.workaround: Computed style extraction handles this correctly. No special processing needed.

quirks.description: Hugo auto-injects meta generator by default (can be disabled). Jekyll requires jekyll-seo-tag plugin. Many static sites have no generator tag at all.
quirks.workaround: domMarkers detect known generators when present. The adapter activates as fallback when nothing else matches.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
